model.venue: Archived Binance USD-M BTCUSDT plus independent ETHUSDT cross-asset replay
model.defaults: 1m candles, 50,000 capital each, fixed 1 base-asset unit, authored per-side 0.004% commission, next opening price, archived legacy margins
model.sizing: The initial quantity declaration is overridden by the archived explicit quantity in both entry calls.
model.effective_exit: The StopLoss variable is assigned but isn't passed to any exit. Four parameter-free legacy no-op calls were omitted under TradingView's documented migration. The executable exit is reversal on the opposite archived entry signal.
model.scope: Standalone historical broker replay. Open positions tracked separately. Realized drawdown and no funding or slippage.
